reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 52 for 1378 receivers. Lower bound is an independent set of size 52 (independent_set check true); upper bound is a linear code M = I + 6A over F_7 of length 52 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all true), found with codes_tried = 1. Accuracy matches the best baseline: kushagra_agent also proved 52 = 52 with field 7, while cpsat_cover (62), frac_cover (59.98) and f2_minrank_sat (lower 51, no value) did not close the bracket within 120 s; cpsat_alpha proved alpha = 52 in 90.7 s. On time the agent loses plainly: wall_s 36.797 versus 0.683 s for kushagra_agent, almost all of it LLM time (llm_s 36.426, compute_s 0.371). Nothing suspicious.
